violated_contract: An action offered on a page where the user is making choices that are not saved yet (stars, merge selections, drops) must carry those choices or refuse; it must never act on the server's last saved state and silently discard what the page shows.
canonical_prevention: Send every action on such a page through the one request that carries the page's current choices (DayReviewPage routes Bundle the day through the same finalize as its bottom button), and pin it with a widget test that makes a choice on the page and then takes the shortcut.
